description: Creates a BRC cash receipt. Accepts either a raw payload object or common flat fields. Customer-ledger receipts require both customerId and acCode resolved for the same customer; neither field alone is sufficient. Analysed receipts may instead supply an analysis allocation without a customer. entryDate defaults to today; procDate defaults to entryDate. The preview shows these resolved dates; carry them into the confirmation call to preserve them if confirming on a later day. VAT rate fields are only sent when the company's VAT on Cash Receipt setting is enabled. Requires a valid routeToken issued for the matching action workflow. The token remains valid through lookup, preview and the permitted transaction. Placeholder tokens are invalid. A routeToken does not bypass preview or explicit-confirmation requirements. A call without confirmWrite: true returns confirmation_required and a payload preview. confirmWrite: true applies the previewed change after explicit confirmation. Passing preflight is not confirmation. Requires confirmCounterpartyExplicit: true; confirmation is scoped to the counterparty selected for the current preview.

acCode.description: Resolved customer account code. Customer-ledger receipts also require customerId for the same customer; analysed receipts can omit both.

companyName.description: Company context name, for example YOUR-COMPANY-NAME.

confirmCounterpartyExplicit.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly named or confirmed the customer, supplier, or other counterparty in the current conversation. Never set true because a customer or supplier appeared in an earlier preview, was inferred from context, or was filled in without the user's explicit choice in this conversation.

confirmWrite.description: Must be true only after a plain-English preview before posting has been shown in the current conversation and the user explicitly confirmed posting (for example yes, create it / post it now / confirm). Never set true on the first call or because the user initially asked to create something. Nothing is written to Big Red Cloud until you confirm.

connectionRef.description: Opaque Red connection reference returned by brc_confirm_company_connection. Pass this exact value on every later tool call when the MCP client rotates session ids (for example Vibe/Mistral). Keep reusing the same connectionRef after successful tool calls — do not start a new connection because a lookup returned empty or partial data. It is not an API key and does not contain credentials.

customerId.description: Resolved customer id. Customer-ledger receipts also require acCode for the same customer; analysed receipts can omit both.

entryDate.description: Entry date; defaults to today and is shown in the preview.

payload.description: Raw cash-receipt fields. Customer-ledger mode requires both customerId and acCode for the same resolved customer; analysed mode uses analysis allocation instead.

procDate.description: Processing date; defaults to entryDate and is shown in the preview.

reference.description: Cash receipts do not support reference in the documented BRC API. Use detailCollection for audit or bank-reference text.

routeToken.description: Opaque routeToken from brc_route_request for this action workflow. Required for transactional tools. Routing permission only — does not replace preview-before-posting or confirmWrite.

name: brc_create_cash_receipt
title: Create Cash Receipt
